newsitem.title: EGYPT: Credit Foncier Egyptien says yr-end profit up.
newsitem.headline: Credit Foncier Egyptien says yr-end profit up.

text.p: Credit Foncier Egyptien, the state real estate bank which issued five-year corporate bonds in 1995, said on Sunday it made an after-tax distributable profit of four million pounds ($1.2 million) in 1995/6, 25 percent up on 3.19 million in 1994/5. The years end on June 30.
The bank's total assets at the end of the year were worth 2.364 billion pounds, up from 2.058 billion one year earlier.
The bonds, with a nominal value of 10 million pounds, are at a fixed interest rate of 12 percent, higher than for all those issued on the Egyptian market this year.
